recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century soul group portrait featuring four men in coordinated terracotta-colored jackets and white trousers, posed against a dark, moody background with a prominent geometric sans-serif title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the bright white trousers and the dark, shadowy background
Rhythmic repetition of the terracotta jacket color across the four subjects
Tight vertical alignment of the subjects creating a staggered depth
Integration of thin-line and heavy-weight typography in a single header line
coreInvariants: Dark, low-key lighting in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a tiered, triangular formation occupying the central and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure sitting slightly lower than the others, creating a stable base for the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the high-contrast white text at the top, moves down through the faces of the group, and settles on the bright white trousers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy shadows and dark background space at the top and sides to emphasize the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cream/white for trousers and scarves.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation on the jackets with high value contrast between the white clothing and dark environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width within each weight class
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters are often interlocking or perfectly circular to emphasize geometry
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast: pairing a hairline weight with a heavy bold weight of the same geometric family.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s-70s geometric soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and weight pairing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in 1960s soul attire (terracotta jackets, white trousers, white scarves) posed in a dark studio with dramatic shadows and a tiered seating arrangement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single line of geometric sans-serif text in all-caps at the top. Use a hairline weight for the first half and a heavy bold weight for the second half, separated by a thin slash.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear weight contrast in the title?
Are the jackets the correct terracotta hue?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the accent jacket color
mustRedesign: The specific faces of the individuals
The exact wording of the title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white trousers are the brightest element in the photo
Verify the title is perfectly horizontal and centered
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark to make the white text pop
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans Type + Tiered Group Portrait + Terracotta/White/Black Palette = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
